recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio photograph of three men in dark suits interacting with bald, white female mannequins, set against a flat white void. The composition is anchored by a heavy, multi-colored slab-serif title that is aggressively sheared and layered over the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Interplay between organic human faces and synthetic mannequin forms
Aggressive diagonal shear in typography contrasting with vertical human figures
Primary color pops (magenta, cyan, red) against a neutral black and white base
Tight grouping of subjects creating a dense central cluster in an open field
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are clustered in the center-right, occupying roughly 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, magenta and blue block lettering in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold magenta text, follows the diagonal shear down through the blue text, and leads into the faces of the men and mannequins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive flat white negative space surrounding the central cluster, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Flat white background providing maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal in the men's suits.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta and bright cyan used for text fills; saturated red and blue in mannequin clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text and mannequin outfits against low-value suits and high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Thick black outer stroke on all glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning causing serifs to almost touch
Overlapping lines between stacked text rows
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with color variation to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and geometric structure.
Classic mid-century slab serif with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph three men in 1960s mod suits posing with three bald white mannequins. One mannequin wears a red dress, another a blue skirt. The lighting should be flat and bright against a seamless white studio backdrop. High angle shot.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, extra-bold slab serif text in all-caps. Shear the text horizontally to the right. Use magenta for the top lines and cyan for the bottom lines. Add a thick black stroke to all letters. Position the text so it partially overlaps the heads of the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without shadows?
Does the text have a heavy black outline?
Are the mannequins bald and stark white?
Is the text sheared at a sharp diagonal?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the heavy shear.
Check that the white mannequins don't bleed into the white background (use subtle outlines if needed).
Verify the color palette remains limited to primary/secondary pops.
Confirm the composition feels 'top-heavy' due to text placement.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio photography of [Subject] + [Surreal Prop] on white background + Sheared Slab Serif Display Type with heavy outlines.
